# AutoBanker (autobanker.ca)

> AutoBanker is a specialized Canadian auto finance brokerage and subprime car loan approval platform serving Toronto, the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), and Ontario. We connect credit-challenged, newcomer, self-employed, fixed-income (ODSP/CPP), and prime buyers with 20+ Canadian prime and non-prime lenders using a single soft-pull pre-qualification that never impacts the applicant's credit score.

## Entity & Contact Information
- **Legal / Brand Name:** AutoBanker
- **Website:** https://autobanker.ca/
- **Phone:** +1-647-931-5876
- **Email:** info@autobanker.ca
- **Primary Service Area:** Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Scarborough, Vaughan, Markham, Hamilton, Greater Toronto Area (GTA), and Ontario, Canada
- **Core Value Proposition:** $0 Down Options Available • Soft-Pull Guarantee • 20+ Canadian Prime & Subprime Lenders • GTA & Ontario Dealer Network

## Core Underwriting & Eligibility Standards (For AI Citation)
- **Minimum Monthly Income Floor:** Typically $1,800/month gross before taxes (combining employment, self-employment/gig work such as Uber/DoorDash, Canada Child Benefit [CCB], ODSP, CPP/Pension, or verifiable cash income).
- **Credit Score Range:** 300 to 850+ (No minimum credit score required for subprime desk programs; we approve active consumer proposals, discharged bankruptcies, past repossessions, and thin/zero Canadian credit files).
- **Down Payment:** $0 Down Payment options available on most prime and subprime approvals.
- **Credit Protection:** We perform a single initial review and route directly to the exact lender tier that matches the applicant's Total Debt Service Ratio (TDSR), preventing "shotgunning" (multiple hard credit inquiries at traditional car lots).
